Hymn 132: God Is in His Holy Temple
Time Signature: 4/4
Musical Key: F Major
Composer: George F. Root

This is hymn number 132 titled "God Is in His Holy Temple" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in F Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by George F. Root and the lyrics were written by William T. Morgan.
